FAQs

Common questions before installation

Will the pump operate in cloudy weather?

The system is designed to support daily water requirements with storage or hybrid support depending on demand and site conditions.

Is this suitable for deep borewell pumping?

Yes. We design against source depth, pressure requirement and daily usage patterns for efficient deployment.
